license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to practice podiatry in this state unless such person has been issued a valid and current license to practice podiatry by this board as provided by this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: Direct the division to issue a license for applicants who successfully pass the examination for the practice of podiatry

age_minimum.quote: is at least eighteen (18) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: is of good moral character and has graduated from a college of podiatric medicine

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine from accredited college
degree_required.quote: has graduated from a college of podiatric medicine which is accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education or its successor organization

accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education or its successor organization

required.quote: Successfully complete at least a one-year residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education or its successor organization.

duration.quote: Successfully complete at least a one-year residency program

kind.quote: at least a one-year residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

exams.name: Board examination (or National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners)
exams.quote: Pass the examination conducted or accepted by the board

interval_years.quote: Each person licensed to practice as a podiatrist in this state shall biennially apply to the board for renewal of the person's license

required.quote: every licensed podiatrist must obtain at least fifteen (15) hours of continuing medical education each calendar year in programs approved by the board

hours_per_period.quote: must obtain at least fifteen (15) hours of continuing medical education each calendar year

period_years.quote: at least fifteen (15) hours of continuing medical education each calendar year

available.quote: the board, in its discretion, may waive the examination required by § 63-3-109(c)(3) and may issue a license to any applicant who holds or possesses a valid license to practice podiatry in another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state with requirements at least equivalent to Tennessee's, and pay the required fee.
requirements.quote: the requirements for licensure in such state are, in the opinion of the board, at least equivalent to the requirements for licensure provided by this chapter and that such applicant pays a fee as set by the board

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to practice podiatry in this state unless such person has been issued a valid and current license to practice podiatry by this board

title_protection.quote: If any person uses any name or title that would designate that person as a podiatrist or imply that that person was or is qualified to practice podiatry under this chapter, it is deemed prima facie evidence of practicing within the meaning of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to practice podiatry in this state unless such person has been issued a valid and current license to practice podiatry by this board as provided by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in procuring a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in procuring a license or certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, drug offense, or offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of any offense under state or federal drug laws or conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral, unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral, unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable conduct;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation by agents or profiting from acts of persons representing themselves as agents of the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation by agents or persons or profiting by the acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensee or the certificate holder;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for bringing or referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide fees received for professional services with any person for bringing or referring a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional association to circumvent the chapter or lending one's name to another for illegal practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with any person, firm or corporation in any manner in an effort to avoid and circumvent this chapter or lending one's name to another for the illegal practice of podiatry by such person;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of the chapter, any lawful board order, or any criminal statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or attempted violation, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate this chapter or any lawful order of the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving testimonials concerning secret therapeutic agents or proprietary preparations claiming radical cure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving of testimonials, directly or indirectly, concerning the supposed virtue of secret therapeutic agents or proprietary preparations, such as remedies, vaccines or other articles or materials that are offered to the public, claiming radical cure or prevention of disease by their use;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false statements or representations or fraud or deceit in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false statements or representations or being guilty of fraud or deceit in the practice of podiatry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in a field in which the licensee is not licensed or not within the limits of their calling
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Invasion of a field of practice in which the licensee is not licensed to practice or is not within the limits of the licensee's respective callings;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing or prescribing controlled substances not in the course of professional practice or not in good faith
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance or any other drug not in the course of professional practice or not in good faith to relieve pain and suffering, or not to cure an ailment, physical infirmity or disease;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing or prescribing controlled substances in violation of state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance, controlled substance analogue or any other drug to any person in violation of any law of the state or of the United States;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a trade name or using a title other than 'podiatrist'
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing podiatry under any trade name or a name designating a given location or the name of another podiatrist or any name other than that which appears on the practitioner's license or using any title other than "podiatrist"

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of the rules and regulations that may be promulgated by the board of podiatric medical examiners to regulate advertising by practitioners who are under the jurisdiction of the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or signing a professional certificate known to be false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time one makes or signs such certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of podiatry when mentally or physically unable to safely do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of podiatry when mentally or physically unable to safely do so;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross health care liability or a pattern of negligence or incompetence in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of the practice of podiatry.

definition_quote.value: one who examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair, including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications, but excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot
definition_quote.quote: one who examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair, including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications, but excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot

methods_authorized.quote: examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair, including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists are authorized to prescribe drugs and medications within the scope of podiatric practice
drug_authority.quote: including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair

amputation_authorized.quote: excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: A licensed podiatrist may perform ankle surgery only when that podiatrist meets the requirements of either subdivision (b)(1) or (b)(2)

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Has completed a surgical residency program at least twenty-four (24) months in length that has been approved by the council on podiatric medical education and is currently eligible for certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: A licensed podiatrist may perform ankle surgery only in an accredited hospital or ambulatory surgical treatment center licensed under title 68 at which the podiatrist has surgical privileges to perform ankle surgery.

board_certification_body.quote: obtain certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery from the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: no person shall perform X-ray procedures in a podiatrist office who does not meet these standards and who has not received a certificate of proficiency from the board.

ankle_surgery_board_certification_timeli.value: within six years of May 24, 2000, or within six years of first becoming eligible for certification, whichever is later
ankle_surgery_board_certification_timeli.quote: must obtain certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery from the American Board of Podiatric Surgery within six (6) years of May 24, 2000, or within six (6) years of first becoming eligible for certification, whichever date is later

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: may not perform surgery on Pilon fractures or tibial fractures that do not enter the ankle joint

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A licensed podiatrist may collaborate with a physician assistant or an orthopedic physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 19 of this title.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: No part or portion of this chapter shall be deemed to prohibit the usual and customary commercial sale and adjustment of foot appliances and remedies or shoes in retail stores.

ankle_surgery_standard_of_care_reference.quote: A licensed podiatrist who performs ankle surgery must meet the same standard of care applicable to orthopedic surgeons who perform ankle surgery.
